dave_customer: Hey team — we saw a bunch of 401s yesterday and our billing shows a sudden jump. Request IDs: req_8X2Y..., req_8X2Z... example response: 401 Unauthorized. Can you help repro?

alice_support: Sorry you're seeing this, @dave_customer. Can you paste the original curl that hit our API (with tokens redacted)? Also any invoice or billing ID you saw.

dave_customer: Curl I used (token replaced):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -D '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"Hello"}'
```
Billing ID: bill_2026_03_12_42 (from dashboard).

alice_support: Thanks. Can you also share the raw response headers/body (redact any user text) and the X-Request-ID response header if present? Those help trace through edge proxies.

dave_customer: Pasted a snippet (redacted):
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2026 18:02:11 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-ID: req_8X2Yabcd

{"error":"unauthorized", "message":"invalid api key"}
```

carol_privacy: Heads up — when you share logs please remove customer PII (user messages, emails, account ids). Prefer using our sanitization helper. Example sed/jq pattern: mask bearer token and email addresses.

carol_privacy: Quick scrub example to run locally before uploading:
```bash
cat raw_response.json \
  | jq '.headers["Authorization"] = "REDACTED"' \
  | sed -E 's/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/[REDACTED_EMAIL]/g' \
  > sanitized_response.json
```

bob_sre: From infra side, 401s usually mean auth failure upstream. I can correlate using X-Request-ID. @dave_customer can you confirm both failing request IDs and an approximate time window? Also include client IP if available.

dave_customer: Time window: 2026-03-12 17:58-18:10 UTC. Client IPs are in our logs, will scrub and share.

erin_product: FYI we also saw a billing delta for that org. Putting this on the billing triage list — @alice_support please attach the invoice id to the support ticket once you have the sanitized logs.

alice_support: Will do. To streamline, please run our debug collector which bundles traces + minimal logs. Command (redact before upload):
```
ri debug-collect --request-ids req_8X2Yabcd,req_8X2Zefgh --window "2026-03-12T17:55:00Z/2026-03-12T18:15:00Z" --output debug_package.tar.gz
```
Then scrub with: `ri scrub debug_package.tar.gz --remove-user-content --mask-keys Authorization,Cookie`

bob_sre: If you can't run ri, paste the X-Request-ID and we'll pull the traces on our side, but we will only fetch metadata until privacy confirms.

carol_privacy: On our side, approved scrub rules: replace any bearer-like token with `<REDACTED_TOKEN>`, replace email-like strings with `<REDACTED_EMAIL>`, and hash account IDs with a salted HMAC. If you want, I can run a quick check after you upload the scrubbed bundle.

dave_customer: Uploading sanitized bundle now to the secure share link you sent earlier. Token removed, messages masked. Should be under filename sanitized_debug_171234.tgz.

deploy-bot: [auto] trace pulled for req_8X2Yabcd by bob_sre at 2026-03-12T18:06:22Z.

bob_sre: Got the bundle. Initial look: auth service returned 401 with upstream code 401 from token verifier. Next step: we'll verify whether token rotation happened for that org around that time and check for clock skew.

alice_support: I'll update the ticket with steps and next actions: 1) bob to confirm cause (sre) 2) carol to validate scrub 3) erin to confirm billing adjustment if we find a platform error.

erin_product: If SRE confirms a platform-side auth regression, we'll create a billing credit workflow and notify the customer.

carol_privacy: Bundle check complete — no user content, tokens masked correctly. Safe to share with product for billing review.

bob_sre: Root cause: brief key-propagation delay during a config rollout at 2026-03-12T17:59:30Z. Tokens issued before propagation could get rejected. We'll revert the rollout and put a guard to avoid partial key states.

alice_support: Thanks everyone. @dave_customer we'll issue a billing credit for the affected window and keep you posted on the mitigation. Anything else you need? :thumbsup:

dave_customer: That's great. Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear scrub instructions.

alice_support: Closing the loop in the ticket now and adding mitigation notes in the internal KB (auth/rollout-guidance)."
